players.product: CMP polishing pads (hard and soft pads), CMP slurries and post-CMP cleaning solutions; immersion ArF and KrF wafer photoresists (8 grades on volume orders, 300-ton Qianjiang line ramping)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: H1 2026 net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 529 million, up 70.21% year over year; Q2 net profit attributable was RMB 279 million, up 10.97% quarter over quarter and 63.76% year over year. H1 semiconductor segment revenue was RMB 1.262 billion, up 33.87%, and the semiconductor materials segment gross margin was 71.93%, clearly higher than a year earlier. H1 R&D spending was RMB 296 million, up 18.69% and 15.39% of revenue; H1 fixed-asset depreciation was about RMB 111 million. The company said the new 300-ton photoresist line has started depreciating and, with heavy R&D, weighs on near-term profit ('upfront investment, later returns').
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net profit attributable RMB 5.29 hundred million (+70.21%); Q2 RMB 2.79 hundred million (+10.97% QoQ, +63.76% YoY); H1 semiconductor revenue RMB 12.62 hundred million (+33.87%); semiconductor materials gross margin 71.93%; R&D RMB 2.96 hundred million (+18.69%, 15.39% of revenue); depreciation about RMB 1.11 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CMP polishing pads: H1 2026 pad revenue was RMB 745 million, up 56.83%; June monthly shipments exceeded 50,000 pads for the first time, a record. The Wuhan hard-pad line's monthly capacity was raised to 50,000 pads in Q1 2026 and the existing main lines run at high utilization. The company is building Wuhan capacity of 400,000 large-silicon-wafer pads a year and Qianjiang capacity of 300,000 glass-substrate and large-size pads a year. The company calls itself the only domestic CMP pad supplier with full in-house pad R&D and process technology and the largest domestic pad supplier, first supplier to several mainstream domestic fabs across memory and logic; it has preliminary cooperation intent with several foreign-owned fabs and is testing and introducing products there. Management: continued expansion at downstream memory and logic fabs and faster localization support pad sales.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 pad revenue RMB 7.45 hundred million (+56.83%); June shipments over 5 ten-thousand pads; Wuhan hard-pad capacity 5 ten-thousand pads per month; new capacity 40 ten-thousand (Wuhan) and 30 ten-thousand (Qianjiang) pads per year

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The third soft-pad line at Qianjiang targets glass-substrate CMP pads and large-size pads (diameter over 2 meters) with planned annual capacity of 300,000 pads; construction has formally started and the line is expected to be completed and start production at the end of 2026, covering substrate manufacturing, wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging.
quarterly_data.figure: planned capacity 30 ten-thousand pads per year; completion expected end of 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging: the company's pads have entered 2.5D and 3D packaging lines and won volume orders from a core panel-level packaging customer, to be introduced gradually into glass-substrate panel-level packaging lines; its glass-substrate soft pad is sampling with customers and has won orders from an important panel-level packaging customer. Its TSV slurry passed validation at a leading domestic advanced-packaging customer; packaging PI and temporary bonding adhesive are in validation. Pads are also shipping with orders into large silicon wafers, third-generation SiC and TSV. The company said glass substrates (TGV) are viewed by the industry as the next-generation interconnect to replace silicon interposers (TSV), with uses in advanced packaging, CPO and HBM; it did not disclose order sizes or customer names.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CMP slurries and cleaning solutions: H1 2026 revenue RMB 193 million, up 63.02%; Q2 revenue RMB 108 million, up 27.33% quarter over quarter and 70.69% year over year; June monthly sales exceeded RMB 40 million. Product progress: large-silicon-wafer final polishing slurry in volume delivery; ceria slurry introduced into a leading domestic memory customer's production line with a first order; TSV slurry passed advanced-packaging customer validation; copper barrier slurry won volume orders from a new customer; SiC substrate slurry won volume orders. Management expects this business's gross margin and profitability to improve further as H2 sales grow.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 1.93 hundred million (+63.02%); Q2 RMB 1.08 hundred million (+27.33% QoQ, +70.69% YoY); June sales over RMB 4,000 ten-thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: High-end wafer photoresist: as of H1 2026, 8 grades (4 immersion ArF and 4 KrF) have volume orders from several mainstream domestic fabs, 5 more than at the end of Q1; H1 orders totaled about 1,000 gallons. The company has more than 40 grades in its portfolio, nearly 30 sampling with customers, over 10 in gallon-sample testing, and expects several to convert into orders this year; H2 focus is converting the gallon-sample products and raising utilization of the Qianjiang phase-2 300-ton line, which is still ramping. Resin and photoacid generator are developed and made in house on what the company calls China's first full-process photoresist line. The company said the photoresist business is suitable for high-end memory and high-performance logic and that segment profitability depends on volume, utilization, depreciation and material costs.
quarterly_data.figure: 8 grades on volume orders (4 ArF immersion, 4 KrF; +5 vs end of Q1); about 1,000 gallons of orders in H1; 40+ grades, nearly 30 sampling, over 10 in gallon-sample testing; 300-ton line

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 target: the company steers by its equity-incentive target — 2026 net profit growth of 350% over the 2023 base, corresponding to net profit attributable of about RMB 1 billion — and will strive to reach it; it is optimistic that the semiconductor business keeps high growth for the full year. It has not disclosed longer-term quantitative targets; capacity additions follow a 'demand-led, phased' principle tied to fab qualification and volume orders.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 net profit attributable target about RMB 10 hundred million (350% growth over 2023)
